description: A phenix workflow config: what applying a workflow branch creates, updates or restarts one experiment from. A phenix.yml file (apiVersion phenix.sandia.gov/v0), checked as `phenix workflow apply` checks it. Generated by src/go/tools/schema-export from the embedded OpenAPI schemas; do not edit.

apiVersion.description: The config API version; a workflow config is phenix.sandia.gov/v0.
apiVersion.title: API Version

kind.description: The config kind, which is always Workflow.
kind.title: Kind

metadata.description: Not read by the server; it is accepted so a workflow config has the same four top-level keys as every other phenix config, and so a later version can carry a name or annotations without a breaking change.
metadata.title: Metadata

spec.description: What an apply may do and the experiment settings it sets; an empty spec applies every default.

auto.description: What an apply may do to the experiment mapped to the workflow branch without being asked.

create.description: The name of the experiment to create when none is mapped to the branch; unset never creates one.
create.title: Create

restart.description: Whether an apply may start a new or updated experiment and stop and restart a running one; defaults to true when unset.
restart.title: Restart

update.description: Whether an apply may update the experiment already mapped to the branch; defaults to true when unset.
update.title: Update

auto.title: Auto

defaultBridge.description: The bridge the experiment's VMs attach to by default; defaults to phenix, is at most 15 characters (the Linux interface name limit), and unless it is phenix no other experiment may use it.
defaultBridge.title: Default Bridge

deployMode.description: Where VMs are deployed, all, no-headnode or only-headnode in any letter case; unset or empty uses the server's deploy-mode setting.
deployMode.title: Deploy Mode

scenario.description: The name of the scenario config; on an update defaults to the experiment's current scenario.
scenario.title: Scenario

schedules.description: VM hostname to cluster host; each listed non-external node of the topology is scheduled on that host.
schedules.title: Schedules

topology.description: The name of the topology config; required to create an experiment, and on an update defaults to the experiment's current topology.
topology.title: Topology

useGREMesh.description: Whether the experiment uses a GRE mesh between cluster hosts; it is OR-ed with the server's use-gre-mesh setting, so either turns it on.
useGREMesh.title: Use GRE Mesh

vlanRange.description: The range of VLAN IDs the experiment may allocate from; unset leaves both ends unset.

max.description: The highest VLAN ID the experiment may use; 0 leaves the maximum unset.
max.title: Maximum

min.description: The lowest VLAN ID the experiment may use; 0 leaves the minimum unset.
min.title: Minimum

vlanRange.title: VLAN Range

vlans.description: VLAN alias to VLAN ID; every alias used by an interface in the topology is set to its ID here, or left for minimega to pick when not listed.
vlans.title: VLANs

spec.title: Workflow Spec

title: phenix Workflow config
